definitions.explanation: Acting without thought or direction, as if groping in the dark.

examples.japanese: やみくも⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{走|はし}った→走る：00519_hashiru⟧。
やみくも⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{努力|どりょく}して→努力する：20201_doryokusuru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{出|で}ない→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: Even if you make efforts blindly, you won't get results.

examples.japanese: やみくもな⟦{挑戦|ちょうせん}→挑戦：03495_chousen⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦しっかり→しっかり：01272_shikkari⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}して→準備する：22427_junbisuru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: Rather than a reckless challenge, it's better to prepare thoroughly before starting.

notes:
Can be written in kanji as {闇雲|やみくも} — literally 'dark clouds,' evoking the image of being unable to see. Most commonly used adverbially as やみくも⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧, but also works as a na-adjective (やみくもな). Always implies a lack of direction or strategy, not just speed or intensity.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- やみくも⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧: to run blindly
- やみくも⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{探|さが}す→探す：00493_sagasu⟧: to search randomly
- やみくも⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{突|つ}き{進|すす}む→突き進む：07266_tsukisusumu⟧: to charge ahead recklessly
- やみくもな⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧: reckless behavior

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {無闇|むやみ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: recklessly; excessively — very close in meaning but also carries a sense of 'excessively' or 'without good reason'
- {闇雲|やみくも}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: same word in kanji — the kana spelling is more common
- がむしゃら⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: frantically; desperately — implies intense single-minded effort rather than lack of direction
- {手当|てあ}たり⟦{次第|しだい}→次第：03175_shidai⟧: at random; indiscriminately — focuses on taking things as they come, one after another
